subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should assistant-media query-token auth be removed now as a secure fail-closed change, or should this shipped fallback get a deprecation or opt-in transition first?
rationale: The code path exposes reusable credentials in request URLs, but the fallback is still present in `v2026.6.11`, so automation should not choose the compatibility window for maintainers.

options.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
options.body: Land this PR as-is and treat bearer auth plus scoped mediaTicket URLs as the supported replacement paths despite breaking query-token media URLs.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a documented deprecation window or explicit compatibility mode before removing query-token assistant-media auth.

options.title: Coordinate with broader auth work
options.body: Pause this focused PR if maintainers want the removal decided together with the broader Control UI hardening and Tailscale media-auth work.

recommendation.title: Accept secure fail-closed removal
recommendation.body: Land this PR as-is and treat bearer auth plus scoped mediaTicket URLs as the supported replacement paths despite breaking query-token media URLs.

likelyOwner.reason: The scoped mediaTicket replacement and related docs/proof came from this area contributor, making them the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
